  (:predicates

    (istable ?s - station)
    (isstove ?s - station)
    (isboard ?s - station)
    (isfryer ?s - station)
    (issink ?s - station)

    ;; Location / player
    (loc ?p - player ?s - station)

    ;; Item location / stacking / holding
    (at ?i - item ?s - station)
    (has ?p - player ?i - item)
    (nothing ?p - player)
    (empty ?s - station)
    (on ?i - item ?s - station)
    (vacant ?s - station)
    (clear ?i - item)
    (atop ?itop - item ?ibot - item)

    ;; Item capabilities / state
    (iscookable ?i - item)
    (iscooked ?i - item)
    (iscuttable ?i - item)
    (iscut ?i - item)
    (isfryable ?i - item)
    (isfryableifcut ?i - item)
    (isfried ?i - item)

    ;; Busy flag
    (item-free ?i - item)
  )

  ; move (duration 1)
  (:durative-action move
    :parameters (?p - player ?from - station ?to - station)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and
      (at start (loc ?p ?from))
      (at start (vacant ?to))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (loc ?p ?from)))
      (at end (loc ?p ?to))
      (at end (vacant ?from))
      (at start (not (vacant ?to)))
    )
  )

      (at start (clear ?i))

      (at start (not (at ?i ?s)))
      (at end (has ?p ?i))
      (at end (empty ?s))
      (at end (not (clear ?i)))
    )
  )

  ; place (duration 1)
  (:durative-action place
    :parameters (?p - player ?i - item ?s - station)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and
      (at start (has ?p ?i))
      (at start (loc ?p ?s))
      (at start (empty ?s))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (has ?p ?i)))
      (at start (not (empty ?s)))

      (at end (at ?itop ?s))
      (at end (atop ?itop ?ibot))
      (at end (clear ?itop))
      (at end (not (clear ?ibot)))

      (at end (clear ?ibot))
      (at end (not (clear ?itop)))

  )

(define (domain robotouille)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types station player item)

  (:predicates
    (isstove ?s - station)
    (isboard ?s - station)
    (isfryer ?s - station)
    (istable ?s - station)
    (issink ?s - station)

    (iscookable ?i - item)
    (iscuttable ?i - item)
    (isfryable ?i - item)
    (isfryableifcut ?i - item)

    (iscooked ?i - item)
    (iscut ?i - item)
    (isfried ?i - item)

    (item-free ?i - item)

    (loc ?p - player ?s - station)
    (at ?i - item ?s - station)
    (nothing ?p - player)
    (empty ?s - station)
    (on ?i - item ?s - station)
    (vacant ?s - station)
    (clear ?i - item)
    (atop ?itop - item ?ibot - item)
    (has ?p - player ?i - item)
  )

  ;; move (duration 1)
  (:durative-action move
    :parameters (?p - player ?from - station ?to - station)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and
      (at start (loc ?p ?from))
      (at start (vacant ?to))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (loc ?p ?from)))
      (at end (loc ?p ?to))
      (at end (vacant ?from))
      (at start (not (vacant ?to)))
    )
  )

  ;; pick-up (duration 1)
  (:durative-action pick-up
    :parameters (?p - player ?i - item ?s - station)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and
      (at start (nothing ?p))
      (at start (on ?i ?s))
      (at start (at ?i ?s))
      (at start (clear ?i))
      (at start (item-free ?i))
      (at start (loc ?p ?s))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (nothing ?p)))
      (at start (not (on ?i ?s)))
      (at start (not (at ?i ?s)))
      (at end (has ?p ?i))
      (at end (empty ?s))
      (at end (not (clear ?i)))
    )
  )

  ;; place (duration 1)
  (:durative-action place
    :parameters (?p - player ?i - item ?s - station)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and
      (at start (has ?p ?i))
      (at start (loc ?p ?s))
      (at start (empty ?s))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (has ?p ?i)))
      (at start (not (empty ?s)))
      (at end (nothing ?p))
      (at end (on ?i ?s))
      (at end (at ?i ?s))
      (at end (clear ?i))
    )
  )

  ;; stack (duration 1)
  (:durative-action stack
    :parameters (?p - player ?itop - item ?ibot - item ?s - station)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and
      (at start (has ?p ?itop))
      (at start (clear ?ibot))
      (at start (loc ?p ?s))
      (at start (at ?ibot ?s))
      (at start (item-free ?itop))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (has ?p ?itop)))
      (at end (nothing ?p))
      (at end (at ?itop ?s))
      (at end (atop ?itop ?ibot))
      (at end (clear ?itop))
      (at end (not (clear ?ibot)))
    )
  )

  ;; unstack (duration 1)
  (:durative-action unstack
    :parameters (?p - player ?itop - item ?ibot - item ?s - station)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and
      (at start (nothing ?p))
      (at start (clear ?itop))
      (at start (atop ?itop ?ibot))
      (at start (loc ?p ?s))
      (at start (at ?itop ?s))
      (at start (at ?ibot ?s))
      (at start (item-free ?itop))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (nothing ?p)))
      (at start (not (at ?itop ?s)))
      (at start (not (atop ?itop ?ibot)))
      (at end (has ?p ?itop))
      (at end (clear ?ibot))
      (at end (not (clear ?itop)))
    )
  )

  ;; cook (duration = 3)
  (:durative-action cook
    :parameters (?p - player ?i - item ?s - station)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and
      (at start (loc ?p ?s))
      (at start (nothing ?p))
      (at start (on ?i ?s))
      (at start (clear ?i))
      (at start (isstove ?s))
      (at start (iscookable ?i))
      (at start (item-free ?i))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (item-free ?i)))
      (at end (iscooked ?i))
      (at end (item-free ?i))
    )
  )

  ;; cut (duration = 3) - robot must stay at board (over all)
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?p - player ?i - item ?s - station)

      (at start (on ?i ?s))
      (at start (clear ?i))
      (over all (loc ?p ?s))
      (at start (isboard ?s))

      (at start (item-free ?i))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (item-free ?i)))
      (at end (iscut ?i))
      (at end (item-free ?i))
    )
  )

  ;; fry (duration = 3)
  (:durative-action fry
    :parameters (?p - player ?i - item ?s - station)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and
      (at start (loc ?p ?s))

      (at start (on ?i ?s))
      (at start (clear ?i))
      (at start (isfryer ?s))
      (at start (isfryable ?i))
      (at start (item-free ?i))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (item-free ?i)))
      (at end (isfried ?i))
      (at end (item-free ?i))
    )
  )

)

(define (problem robotouille-problem)
  (:domain robotouille)

  (:objects
    sink_1 sink_2 sink_3 stove_1 stove_2 fryer_1 board_1 table_1 table_2 table_3 table_4 table_5 - station
    robot_1 - player
    chicken_1 potato_1 bottombun_1 bowl_1 water_1 - item
  )

  (:init
    ;; station types
    (issink sink_1)
    (issink sink_2)
    (issink sink_3)
    (isstove stove_1)
    (isstove stove_2)
    (isfryer fryer_1)
    (isboard board_1)
    (istable table_1)
    (istable table_2)
    (istable table_3)
    (istable table_4)
    (istable table_5)

    ;; player location
    (loc robot_1 sink_1)

    ;; vacant: every station except robot_1's starting station (sink_1)
    (vacant sink_2)
    (vacant sink_3)
    (vacant stove_1)
    (vacant stove_2)
    (vacant fryer_1)
    (vacant board_1)
    (vacant table_1)
    (vacant table_2)
    (vacant table_3)
    (vacant table_4)
    (vacant table_5)

    ;; items on stations (stack-level 0) - EVERY item must have (on ...) and (at ...)
    ;; From environment: chicken_1 on table_4, potato_1 on sink_2, bottombun_1 on table_2
    ;; We place bowl_1 on table_5 (container located there) and water_1 at sink_1.
    (on chicken_1 table_4)
    (at chicken_1 table_4)

    (on potato_1 sink_2)
    (at potato_1 sink_2)

    (on bottombun_1 table_2)
    (at bottombun_1 table_2)

    (on bowl_1 table_5)
    (at bowl_1 table_5)

    (on water_1 sink_1)
    (at water_1 sink_1)

    ;; item capabilities/states
    (iscookable chicken_1)
    (iscuttable potato_1)

    ;; item-free for all items
    (item-free chicken_1)
    (item-free potato_1)
    (item-free bottombun_1)
    (item-free bowl_1)
    (item-free water_1)

    ;; clear facts: items that have nothing on them are clear
    (clear chicken_1)
    (clear potato_1)
    (clear bottombun_1)
    (clear bowl_1)
    (clear water_1)

    ;; empty stations: every station that currently has NO items on it
    ;; Stations that DO have items: table_4, sink_2, table_2, table_5, sink_1
    (empty board_1)
    (empty fryer_1)
    (empty stove_1)
    (empty stove_2)
    (empty table_1)
    (empty table_3)
    (empty sink_3)

    ;; Note: stations with items are not declared (empty). sink_1 has the robot and water_1,
    ;; so it is not empty. table_4, sink_2, table_2, table_5 contain items so are not empty.

    ;; player hand state
    (nothing robot_1)
  )

  ;; Goal: use only declared predicates. Move the bowl to table_1 (achievable goal).
  (:goal (and
    (at bowl_1 table_1)
  ))
)
